title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Conduct Buffer on Catch-Up Deposits
content:
**Cartwise Shopper Payouts — desk guidance on the catch-up conduct buffer**

A catch-up conduct buffer stays on the Cartwise Shopper Payouts balance: a shopper carrying 6 or more active violation points leaves 30.00, a shopper carrying 1 to 5 leaves 12.00, and a shopper carrying none leaves nothing. The buffer is not part of the catch-up deposit.

The active violation points are those shown on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record on the day of the catch-up.

## Input, judgement, output

| Active violation points | Judgement | Buffer left on the balance |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | None carried | Nothing |
| 1 | Within 1 to 5 | 12.00 |
| 5 | Within 1 to 5 | 12.00 |
| 6 | 6 or more | 30.00 |
| 9 | 6 or more | 30.00 |

The threshold sits between 5 and 6 points: 5 active points leaves 12.00, and 6 active points leaves 30.00.

## Hypothetical illustration

A shopper whose contractor account shows 3 active violation points has a catch-up deposit sent; 12.00 stays on the payout balance. Had the account shown 7 active points, 30.00 would stay.
